cards.ex: The opposition accused the government of using stonewalling tactics to avoid debating the controversial bill.
cards.exUz: Muxolifat hukumatni bahsli qonun loyihasini muhokama qilmaslik uchun to'sqinlik usullarini qo'llashda aybladi.
cards.uzDef: Muhokamani qasddan cho'zish, qochish yoki to'xtatish usullari.

cards.ex: The news focuses heavily on campaign finance during each election cycle.
cards.exUz: Yangiliklar har bir saylov davrida kampaniyaning moliyalashtirilishiga katta e'tibor qaratadi.

cards.ex: Candidates often stick to their pre-prepared talking points during debates.
cards.exUz: Nomzodlar ko'pincha munozaralar davomida oldindan tayyorlangan asosiy fikrlariga amal qilishadi.

cards.ex: Political horse-trading is often necessary to pass legislation.
cards.exUz: Qonunchilikni qabul qilish uchun siyosiy kelishuv savdosi ko'pincha zarur bo'ladi.

cards.ex: Every vote counts, so make sure you put your ballot in the ballot box.
cards.exUz: Har bir ovoz muhim, shuning uchun byulleteningizni saylov qutisiga solganingizga ishonch hosil qiling.

cards.ex: The senator used his political clout to secure funding for the project.
cards.exUz: Senator loyihani moliyalashtirishni ta'minlash uchun o'zining siyosiy nufuzidan foydalandi.

cards.ex: She hopes to hold office for many years to come.
cards.exUz: U kelajakda ko'p yillar davomida lavozimda bo'lishga umid qilmoqda.

cards.ex: The dictator's death created a power vacuum, leading to instability.
cards.exUz: Diktatorning o'limi hokimiyat bo'shlig'ini yaratdi va bu beqarorlikka olib keldi.

cards.ex: Special interest groups often donate heavily to political campaigns.
cards.exUz: Manfaatdor guruhlar ko'pincha siyosiy kampaniyalarga katta miqdorda xayriya qilishadi.

cards.ex: After the election, the parties formed a coalition government.
cards.exUz: Saylovdan so'ng partiyalar koalitsion hukumat tuzdilar.

cards.ex: The incumbent president is seeking re-election next year.
cards.exUz: Amaldagi prezident kelgusi yilda qayta saylanishga harakat qilmoqda.

cards.ex: The company was accused of making payments under the table to government officials.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya hukumat amaldorlariga yashirincha to'lovlar qilishda ayblangan.

cards.ex: The budget negotiations were delayed due to political wrangling.
cards.exUz: Byudjet bo'yicha muzokaralar siyosiy kurash tufayli kechiktirildi.

cards.ex: The candidate is spending a lot of time fishing for votes in rural areas.
cards.exUz: Nomzod qishloq joylarda ovoz yig'ishga ko'p vaqt sarflamoqda.

cards.ex: The government claimed to have a strong election mandate to implement its policies.
cards.exUz: Hukumat o'z siyosatini amalga oshirish uchun kuchli saylov mandatiga ega ekanligini da'vo qildi.

cards.ex: The MP decided to cross the floor after disagreeing with the party's new direction.
cards.exUz: Parlament a'zosi partiyaning yangi yo'nalishi bilan kelishmaganidan so'ng, partiyani o'zgartirishga qaror qildi.

cards.ex: The spoils system can lead to corruption and inefficiency in government.
cards.exUz: O'lja tizimi hukumatda korruptsiya va samarasizlikka olib kelishi mumkin.

cards.ex: Watchdog organizations play a crucial role in ensuring government accountability.
cards.exUz: Nazorat tashkilotlari hukumatning javobgarligini ta'minlashda muhim rol o'ynaydi.

cards.ex: The government is trying to push through legislation on environmental protection.
cards.exUz: Hukumat atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish to'g'risidagi qonunni o'tkazishga harakat qilmoqda.

cards.ex: The candidate's grassroots support helped him win the election.
cards.exUz: Nomzodning xalq qo'llab-quvvatlashi unga saylovda g'alaba qozonishga yordam berdi.

cards.ex: There was a lot of political maneuvering behind the scenes before the vote.
cards.exUz: Ovoz berishdan oldin sahnada ko'plab siyosiy manevrlar bo'lib o'tdi.

cards.ex: The current political climate is very tense.
cards.exUz: Hozirgi siyosiy muhit juda keskin.

cards.ex: He is expected to run unopposed in the next election.
cards.exUz: U kelgusi saylovda raqibsiz yugurishi kutilmoqda.

cards.ex: The politician's career suffered a fall from grace after the scandal.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchining faoliyati janjaldan keyin obro'sizlandi.

cards.ex: The public decided to vote the corrupt official out of office.
cards.exUz: Jamoatchilik korruptsiyalashgan amaldorni lavozimdan olib tashlashga qaror qildi.

cards.ex: We need to ensure taxpayer dollars are spent wisely.
cards.exUz: Soliq to'lovchilarning puli oqilona sarflanishini ta'minlashimiz kerak.

cards.ex: The election is expected to go down to the wire.
cards.exUz: Saylov oxirigacha qizg'in kurash bilan o'tishi kutilmoqda.

cards.ex: The debate felt more like political theater than a serious discussion of the issues.
cards.exUz: Munozara jiddiy masalalarni muhokama qilishdan ko'ra, siyosiy teatrga o'xshardi.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqiy maqsadsiz, shunchaki ko'rinish uchun harakat.

cards.ex: He didn't want to rock the boat by disagreeing with the boss.
cards.exUz: U boshliqqa qarshi chiqib, vaziyatni buzishni xohlamadi.

cards.ex: Several government programs are expected to get the axe in the new budget.
cards.exUz: Yangi byudjetda bir nechta hukumat dasturlari bekor qilinishi kutilmoqda.
